cleanup.description: Command to execute after completion of all benchmarking runs for each command

command_names.description: List of meaningful names for each benchmark command (must align with commands order if provided)

commands.description: List of benchmark commands to execute

conclude.description: Command to execute after each timing run

export_asciidoc.description: File path to export timing summary as AsciiDoc table

export_csv.description: File path to export timing summary as CSV

export_json.description: File path to export timing summary and individual run timings as JSON

export_markdown.description: File path to export timing summary as Markdown table

export_orgmode.description: File path to export timing summary as Emacs org-mode table

ignore_failure.description: Ignore non-zero exit codes of the benchmarked programs

input.description: Where input comes from (null or file path)

max_runs.description: Maximum number of runs for each command. 0 means no limit.

min_runs.description: Minimum number of runs for each command

output.description: Where output is redirected (null, pipe, inherit, or file path)

parameter_list.description: List of parameter list configurations for comma-separated values

parameter_scan.description: List of parameter scan configurations for variable ranges

prepare.description: Command to execute before each timing run

reference.description: Reference command for relative comparison of results

runs.description: Exact number of runs for each command. 0 means auto-determine.

setup.description: Command to execute before each set of timing runs

shell.description: Shell to use for executing benchmarked commands (e.g., bash, zsh, none, default)

show_output.description: Print stdout and stderr of the benchmark

sort.description: Sort order of speed comparison summary (auto, command, mean-time)

style.description: Output style type (auto, basic, full, nocolor, color, none)

time_unit.description: Time unit to be used (microsecond, millisecond, second)

warmup.description: Number of warmup runs before the actual benchmark
